newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle sales slow at $64 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle sales slow at $64 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the panhandle area early Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 64.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 64.00.
Sales reported on 300 slaughter steers and 600 heifers; 90,600 head confirmed for week to date which includes 34,500 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
